dataset: ERA5 hourly reanalysis (2 m temperature analysis; snowfall 1-h accumulations from 06/18 UTC forecasts), ARCO-ERA5 copy
url: https://storage.googleapis.com/gcp-public-data-arco-era5/co/ (single-level-reanalysis.zarr-v2 t2m, single-level-forecast.zarr-v2 sf); ar/full_37-1h-0p25deg-chunk-1.zarr-v3 for the ERA5T tail
doi: 10.24381/cds.adbb2d47 (ERA5 hourly single levels); Hersbach et al. 2020, QJRMS, 10.1002/qj.3803; ARCO-ERA5: Carver & Merose 2023

files.name: data/raw/era5/{t2m,sf}/YYYYMM.npz (daily fields north of 45N, native N320 points)

notes: Partial HTTP range reads of blosc block 0 (lat>=45N), low mantissa byte dropped (midpoint). T2m daily mean = mean of 00+12 UTC for 1 Nov-15 May, one analysis/day alternating 00/12 UTC for 16 May-15 Sep (winter 2024 Jun-Sep cached earlier at 2/day); snowfall = 24 x one 1-h accumulation per day, valid hour rotating through 24 h (Nov 2024 also at 4/day for a sampling check). Transfer 36 MB this run in 1318 requests. ERA5T (preliminary) after valid_time_stop. Warm bias over sea ice in cold conditions (Wang et al. 2019).
